articleTitle: When Sleep Medications Stop Working: What CBT-I Treats That Pills Don't
imageHeadline: Still Waking at 2 AM on Sleep Meds? Try CBT-I Instead
imageSubtext: See what this therapy targets that pills miss
pinTitle: CBT-I for insomnia when sleep medications stop working
pinDescription: If you're waking up hours after taking Ambien or other sleep medications, cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia (CBT-I) addresses the patterns that keep you awake—without another prescription. Learn what CBT-I treats that sleep meds don't and how it works for chronic insomnia.
